_comment: Ledger of OpenStax errata IDs manually resolved in this project, independent of git file-add dates. The yearly review's build-date heuristic (comparing an erratum's corrected_date against a section file's git first-add date) cannot detect fixes applied AFTER a file was first built, since it only sees the original build date. Check this ledger FIRST for every live-section, Approved/corrected erratum before falling back to the build-date heuristic. When you manually apply a fix for an erratum (in this scheduled review or any other session), add an entry here so future runs don't re-flag it as needing action.
